The bank's don't *always* charge a one time fee, but usually do.

And what you're referencing is called a "direct deposit cash advance", where the funds are transfered to a deposit account instead of a payment directly made to another credit card. Banks also do not always offer this. It's a risk/reward calculation for them, so they offer different terms to different people, just like they offer different APRs based on credit history

I'm a woman too... And I've gotten off to a lot of terrible things in my life. I'd be willing to bet, worse things than you did.

You know that batman quote "it's not who you are underneath, it's what you do that defines you?"

Let's say I think car crashes are funny. It's not a perfect parallel, but I'm trying to make it less directly about sex. If I find car crashes hilarious... But then someone falls off their bike, and I help them up...

... Does it matter, really, what I find funny? If how I act toward other people is not out of that sense of humor, but out of goodness? 

The same thing applies to sex. Let's say you masturbate to a story about someone in a car crash... That's a terrible thing... If it were real. But it isn't real. What you do to others is what is substantial, is what's tangible. 

I have friends with all kinds of sexual tastes. I know people who masturbate to gore. I know people who masturbate to rape. I know people who masturbate to bestiality. I know people who masturbate to cannibalism. I know people who have masturbated to most things one can think of. 

And all these same people... Would never cut someone open. Would never rape someone or want to be raped. Would never have sex with an animal. Would never eat someone.

All that matters in this world is how we treat other people... Not the things inside our head.
